title: Time is Not a Label: Continuous Phase Rotation for Temporal Knowledge Graphs and Agentic Memory
abstract: arXiv:2604.11544v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Structured memory representations such as knowledge graphs are central to autonomous agents and other long-lived systems. However, most existing approaches model time as discrete metadata, either sorting by recency (burying old-yet-permanent knowledge), simply overwriting outdated facts, or requiring an expensive LLM call at every ingestion step, leaving them unable to distinguish persistent facts from evolving ones. To address this, we introduce RoMem, a drop-in temporal knowledge graph module for structured memory systems, applicable to agentic memory and beyond. A pretrained Semantic Speed Gate maps each relation's text embedding to a volatility score, learning from data that evolving relations (e.g., "president of") should rotate fast while persistent ones (e.g., "born in") should remain stable. Combined with continuous phase rotation, this enables geometric shadowing: obsolete facts are rotated out of phase in complex vector spa

translated_title: 时间并非标签：连续相位旋转用于时间知识图谱与智能体记忆
translated_abstract: 结构化记忆表示（如知识图谱）对于自主智能体和其他长期运行的系统至关重要。然而，现有的大多数方法将时间建模为离散元数据，要么按时间新近性排序（从而埋没了陈旧但永久的知识），要么简单地覆盖过时的事实，要么在每次摄入步骤中需要昂贵的LLM调用，导致它们无法区分持久事实与演化事实。为解决这一问题，我们引入了RoMem，一个即插即用的时间知识图谱模块，适用于结构化记忆系统，可用于智能体记忆及其他场景。一个预训练的语义速度门将每个关系的文本嵌入映射到波动性评分，从数据中学习到演化关系（如“总统”）应快速旋转，而持久关系（如“出生地”）应保持稳定。结合连续相位旋转，这实现了几何遮蔽：过时事实在复杂向量空间中被旋转出相位。
tldr: 本文提出RoMem，一种通过语义速度门和连续相位旋转来区分持久与演化事实的时间知识图谱模块，无需离散时间标签或昂贵LLM调用，即可在智能体记忆中实现几何遮蔽过时信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RoMem, a temporal knowledge graph module that uses a semantic speed gate and continuous phase rotation to distinguish persistent from evolving facts, enabling geometric shadowing of obsolete information in agentic memory without discrete time labels or costly LLM calls.
